kinds.description: Embedded sub-process (expanded by default, use --collapsed to collapse)
Event sub-process (triggeredByEvent=true); create it as eventSubProcess:<trigger> (message|timer|signal|conditional|error|escalation|compensate) to get its start event in the same command
XOR: exactly one outgoing path (name it as a question, name the branches)
OR: one or more outgoing paths
Complex: a custom split / join rule (no Camunda 7 / 8 engine runs it)
Waits for the first of several catching events
Start event (error/escalation/compensate only inside an eventSubProcess)
Boundary event attached to an activity (--on <hostId>)
Pool; the first one wraps the existing process, further ones get a new process (--black-box for none)
Text annotation (connect it to an element to draw an association)
Group drawn around its members (--members <id,...>; the members reference its category value)

none.description: plain event; the default for start/end/throw events in `add` (`retype` keeps the current trigger unless the suffix :none is given)

message.description: root bpmn:Message found by name, created when missing

error.description: root bpmn:Error by name, created when missing

signal.description: root bpmn:Signal by name, created when missing

escalation.description: root bpmn:Escalation by name, created when missing

link.description: a throwing and a catching link event pair up by name
